s1.notes:
Attacks the enemy by continuously firing a gun. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. Penetrates the target's Defense, and cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow. When used on the caster's turn, if the caster is granted determination, activates Settlement as an extra attack.
Settlement: Draws a hidden weapon and attacks all enemies. Damage dealt increases proportional to the caster's max Health. Penetrates the target's Defense, and cannot trigger a critical hit or a heavy blow.
Preview uses the standard attack; Settlement and Soulburn extra attacks are not included.

s2.notes: At the start of the first battle, gains 40 Fighting Spirit. When an ally is attacked, if expected damage suffered is equivalent to 20% or more of max Health, consumes 10 Fighting Spirit, granting 50% damage reduction. When an ally dies, grants determination to the caster and increases Combat Readiness by 50%.

s3.notes: Dispels two debuffs from an ally and the caster, and grants increased Attack for 2 turns. Increases Combat Readiness of the ally by 30%.

notes: Both awakened profiles and self imprint verified. Conditional skill limitations appear in each skill note. No build archetype assigned.
